map_aria: The learning route: three stages, {count} blocks of exercises
map_free_title: Real text from your open keys only, off the route
map_here_all: The whole route is done. Repeat any block.
map_goal_g1_home: The anchor keys, the space bar and the first new home-row letters. Fingers stay in place.
map_goal_g1_top: Reaching up from the home row and back, key by key, and each finger's full span.
map_goal_g1_bottom: Reaching down from the home row and back. After every key the finger returns home.
map_goal_g1_shift: Shift with the opposite little finger, and the digit row as moves of their own.
map_goal_g1_symbols: Punctuation, the apostrophe and the rarer keys.
map_goal_g2_ladder: Real words from your open keys: from the first short ones to long ones.
map_goal_g2_keys: Every new key brings the words it appears in.
map_goal_g2_sets: Separate skills in words: alternating hands, double letters, the apostrophe, capitals.
map_goal_g3_keys: Warm-up, letters and the most frequent letter pairs.
map_goal_g3_syllables: Syllables, morphemes, consonant clusters and whole words.
map_goal_g3_phrases: Punctuation in phrases, and full sentences.
map_goal_g3_text: Continuous text, dictations and metronome series.
map_review_body: Your weakest keys and moves from your attempts, and one exercise on exactly those. Always open, at any stage.
map_finish_1: Stage 1 is done when every scale is mastered and the last five attempts average 96% accuracy or more.
map_finish_2: Stage 2 is done when every word exercise that has enough words from your open keys is mastered.
map_finish_3: The Academy is done when every exercise of every module is mastered.
map_detail_all_done: Everything in this block is mastered. Any exercise can be repeated.
map_detail_locked: This block is still locked. Each exercise says what opens it.
map_mastery: Mastered means {target} test attempts in a row at {floor}% accuracy or more. Speed never blocks.
map_review_empty_title: Nothing to review yet — and that is fine
map_review_step1_body: Any exercise counts: scales, words or the Academy.
map_review_step2_body: A key or a move is judged only after five presses on it.
map_review_step3_body: The slowest and most-missed ones show up here, with one exercise on exactly those.
map_review_empty_free: Real text from your open keys only, off the route.
map_own_lead: Paste a text or pick a .txt or .md file.
map_own_error_size: the file is too large, up to 20 KB.
map_own_error_chars: not on this layout: {chars}. Remove them or switch language.
